tasks.title: Survey GSD
tasks.solution: GSD = H·w_sensor/(f·W_px). Units: H in meters; the sensor width and focal length in millimeters cancel out, and ×100 converts to centimeters.

tasks.title: Trigger spacing from overlap
tasks.solution: Footprint along the line = 2H·tan(FOV/2), spacing = footprint·(1 − overlap). This is the value that goes into DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST.

tasks.title: Distance between survey lines
tasks.solution: The same formula for the cross direction. The long side of the frame across the survey line means fewer lines and a shorter mission.
